sentences.text: Penal Code vs In Re: Riyajul Mondal on 11 June, 2024
Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen 11.06.2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of the Code  Criminal Procedure in connection with Haringhata Police Station Case No. 2  of 2024 dated 11.05.2024 under Sections 498A/302/304B/34 of the Indian  Penal Code.
 And  In Re: Riyajul Mondal  Petitioner  Ms. Sananda Bhattacharyya  For the Petitioner  Mr. Madhusudan Sur, Ld. APP  Ms. Suchismita Dutta  For the State  1.
The petitioner is the uncle-in-law of the victim.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner resides at a different address and he has been falsely implicated in the instant case.

3. Learned counsel for the State in opposing the prayer for anticipatory bail has referred to the statement of the neighbours recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C to show that the victim is subjected to severe torture by the family members of the husband of the victim which includes the name of the present petitioner.
It is further submitted that the victim died within one year and eight months of marriage.

4. Considering the materials available in the case diary and the nature of involvement of the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence and having regard to the fact that the statement Penal Code vs In Re: Riyajul Mondal on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85161607/
1 of the neighbours recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected and the same is accordingly disposed of.
6. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J) (Uday Kumar , J)
